name: Combination Discipline — Draught of the Soul

system.description:
Many Assamites, particularly the warrior caste's adherents of the Road of Blood, raise the potency of their vitae through Amaranth. This art allows the diablerist to drain not only her victim's power but also his knowledge. Teachers advise sparing use, since frequent practice can leave the diablerist's mind a shattered ruin full of her victims' memories.

This power may be used whenever the character successfully commits diablerie. The player spends Willpower Traits equal to the victim's Mental Attributes and makes a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty equal to the victim's permanent Willpower (plus one Trait for every derangement he had, as a bonus difficulty Trait). Success grants a pool of experience usable only toward Abilities in which the victim's rating equalled or exceeded the diablerist's own, plus dreamlike flashes of the victim's most significant memories (Storyteller's discretion — parcel out hints, not plot-breaking knowledge). A failed challenge grants no knowledge and inflicts a permanent derangement (preferably one the victim possessed). Costs 20 Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
